title: Listening Drill — Recording the school garden — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Recording the school garden — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on recording the school garden last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with overlapping leaves. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: missing stake.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of leaf count so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow plant chart instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the garden tutor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Tuesday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
